description: Control arm for the 2026-08-06 YouTube-corpus A/B. Zeroes every parameter added for findings F001/F002/F003 (11e Hidden awareness), F004 (Overwatch exposure) and F009 (battle-shock as objective denial), and pins the deep-strike denial radius back to the legacy fixed 9" (360px) that F007 replaced with a derivation. Applying this to P2 recovers the pre-change AI for that player while P1 and the code are identical in both arms, so the margin difference isolates the findings.
